summary: Validated refactoring that moved PDF routes from routes/agent.py to routes/pdf_import.py. All 12 backend tests pass including smoke (login, projects list, agent session create, agent analyze still registered) and the 5 refactored PDF routes (upload-chunk, pdf-preview GET/POST, generate-faithful-course, repair-pdf-images, faithful-status) with correct contracts. Frontend RemoveBackgroundDialog was code-verified: ElementProperties.jsx renders the 'Remover Fundo' button with data-testid='image-remove-bg-btn' when element.type==='image', and the dialog has all required test ids (bg-preview-canvas, bg-tolerance-slider, bg-softness-slider, bg-color-picker, bg-apply-btn, bg-cancel-btn). Interactive UI click-through could not be completed because all available projects are PPT-imports rendered as whole-slide background images with zero element children (editor shows '0 elementos'); no individual image element exists to select in the DB-seeded data.
action_items: None blocking. Optionally, main agent can verify the RemoveBackgroundDialog end-to-end by creating a project with a real image element (e.g., via Agent flow or drag/drop image in Editor) and clicking it — the button and dialog are wired correctly in code.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pdf_import.py (813 lines) is a clean, well-documented extraction. Same URL prefixes (/agent/sessions, /projects) preserved; helpers (_PDF_EXTRACTION_TASKS, _page_hint_from_filename, _background_pdf_extraction, _background_faithful_render) kept encapsulated in the new module.
server.py (lines 121-122) correctly registers pdf_import_routes.router with prefix='/api'. All 5 expected endpoints verified live via pytest.
Refactor is non-breaking: /api/agent/sessions/{id}/analyze (stayed in agent.py) still responds (not 404). /api/projects listing still works. /api/auth/login still works.

generate-faithful-course correctly returns 400 with message 'PDF original nao disponivel' when rawFileGridFS missing (not 500). upload-chunk returns clean 404 'Session not found' for unknown session (no NoneType). faithful-status returns 404 for unknown project as expected.
Frontend ElementProperties.jsx: 'Remover Fundo' button correctly gated on element.type==='image' and imports/uses RemoveBackgroundDialog. Passes imageUrl, projectId, onApply, onClose props correctly.

Frontend RemoveBackgroundDialog.jsx: implements color-key background removal fully in-browser via canvas, samples 4 corners to auto-detect key color, supports eye-dropper pick, tolerance+softness sliders, uploads result PNG via POST /api/projects/{id}/media. All interactive elements have data-testids.

success_rate.frontend: Code verified — interactive click-through not completed (no image-element projects available to seed the test)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded projects are all PPT-imported and have no selectable image elements; editor shows '0 elementos' for them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If retesting the Remover Fundo dialog end-to-end is required, create a brand new project via the Agente IA flow that generates image elements (not PPT-import), or use the Editor toolbar's 'Insert Image' button and upload a PNG — then click the inserted image. The button and dialog data-testids are: image-remove-bg-btn, bg-preview-canvas, bg-tolerance-slider, bg-softness-slider, bg-color-picker, bg-apply-btn, bg-cancel-btn, bg-reset-btn, bg-picker-btn.
